la:noun:xystus.gloss: covered portico or gallery (or one planted with trees)
senses: covered portico or gallery (or one planted with trees)
la:noun:xystus.html:
xystus, i, m., or xystum, i, n., = ξυστός or ξυστόν.
Among the Greeks, a covered portico or gallery, where the athletes exercised in winter, ; ; .—
Among the Romans, an open colonnade or portico, or a walk planted with trees, etc., for recreation, conversation, philosophic discussion, etc., ; ; ; ; ; ; ; 9, 36, 3; ; .
